requiredFindings.title: Restore an exact pinned CI-A2 context before accepting the package
requiredFindings.description: The subject manifest itself matches its requested 1,075-byte pin, and CI-A3-r2.md, CI-A3-r1.md and PROPOSAL-r5.md match their member pins. The fourth member, ci-2-r1/SCOPE.md, does not: the manifest requires 21,806 bytes with SHA-256 29f4590b34c05eef5318e4229e1901fd6923339071bb66d34c23c1d0b4742dc2; the live path contains 24,520 bytes with SHA-256 02be51f77c59abebd14e5c0f401de1c5f639246782de27a77d746a835d71c2b1. Thus the assertion that every context member is unchanged from round 1 cannot be verified, and the submitted manifest does not identify the context bytes presently available at that path.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Supply the originally pinned context at an immutable review path and update the subject to point there, or rebase this amendment against the intended changed CI-A2 context and issue a matching subject manifest. Do not overwrite the in-flight CI-2 subject merely to satisfy this review. Recheck the relevant interface/price dependencies against the resulting exact context.
requiredFindings.validationExpectation: Independently rehash all four subject entries and require every member length/hash to match. Preserve the old history artifact and state explicitly whether the new round retains the old context or adopts a revised CI-A2 context.

requiredFindings.title: Separate exact executed charges from the remaining per-member upper bounds
requiredFindings.description: CI-T28 requires the run's charges to equal B_launch for actual counts, but the B_launch table still prices each lookup at at most ceil(log2 n)+1 comparisons and file reads at env(c), a read-attempt envelope. These are bounds, not necessarily executed counts. The reused charged_find charges each comparison actually made, and read_verified charges each read attempt until EOF. A zero-byte file needs one EOF read, while env(0)=2; a lookup can likewise match before its comparison bound. The new equality assertion therefore conflicts with the stated reused per-operation charging model even though the content/path quantities and representation charges have been corrected.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Either define a distinct exact accounting expression using independently observed comparison counts and read-attempt counts, with actual charges equal to that expression and bounded by B_launch and Bhat_launch, or redefine B_launch with explicit actual counts and reserve the comparison/read envelopes for its conservative bound. Do not precharge unused comparisons or perform unnecessary reads solely to satisfy the equality. Keep every charge before its actual operation and preserve typed Budget propagation.
requiredFindings.validationExpectation: Use an empty file, a one-chunk file and lookups that match at different search depths. The independently enumerated executed total must match actual charges even when strictly below the envelope; verify the bound inequalities separately, including one-unit-short failures before actual operations.

rulings.Q1: The content/path-length and owned-spelling corrections are accepted in design: c, p, b, k, h, q_i, L and P are distinct; the file basename includes its terminator; desc already covers descent spellings; the single P+1 launch buffer may be observed as CStr and transferred into the result without another allocation; and the store record has a separate one-time charge. Directory("") has zero resolution/descent work and a fresh retained-handle status plus path binding. Full accounting acceptance is withheld pending RF-2 and the exact-context correction RF-1. The proposed maxima dominate valid request work in principle, provided the root special case and empty symlink/directory maxima are explicitly handled without an undefined maximum, all final-path segment lengths are bounded and checked arithmetic precedes allocation. Actual comparisons/read attempts are not their envelopes.
rulings.Q2: Accepted. The new platform-owned path_status_no_follow(&CStr, work) can observe the exact absolute spelling and return kind/device/inode without allocating another path; directory_identity can obtain kind/mode/identity from the retained directory handle. Reusing P-7's st price is appropriate for one charged lstat/fstat. This accurately addresses NBO-1: the permitted CI-2 candidate's entry_status is single-component and omits identity, while sample_identity observes a TreeFile. Keep ENOENT/ENOTDIR and wrong kind/identity as Binding at the launch seam, true native observation errors as Io and refused charges as Budget. Off-macOS unsupported outcomes must be represented through the declared error types before charging; this adds no Linux standing. The pinned-context mismatch does not invalidate the amendment's explicit new primitive design.
rulings.Q3: Accepted. Charge the one owned L-byte admitted absolute store-path record immediately before its sole copy in ComponentStore::open_in, and in the fixture constructor, on the opening owner's existing ledger. It is not a per-launch cost, and it does not confer path authority. Adding a WorkScope changes the CI-3L constructor/call-site interface and must preserve typed Budget failure rather than collapse it into io::Error or create a new ledger. Account for exact path construction without unpriced intermediate joins. Carry the one-time term in the opening owner's model and control; the later launch recipe reuses it without charging it again. These changes belong after CI-2/CI-3 integration, not in its in-flight candidate.
